content.text: The existing architecture points to one new lint module, one test module, and one explicit registration entry. No hook or shared-framework change appears necessary. I’m checking the repository’s verification conventions before fixing the proposed signatures and test matrix.

The `verify-commands` skill is shaping the handoff checks: each command will be rooted at this repository and paired with a concrete failure signal, so a zero-test or wrong-path run cannot masquerade as verification.

command: ls -ld . .venv pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null; test -x .venv/bin/python && .venv/bin/python --version; rg -n "pytest" pyproject.toml | sed -n '1,120p'; rg -n "^\[tool\.pytest|testpaths|python_files" pyproject.toml

rg -n "tests/dev/lint|pytest .*dev/lint|python -m pytest|\.venv/bin/pytest|uv run pytest|just test" CONTRIBUTING.md README.md Justfile justfile pyproject.toml .github dev 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,320p'
find dev/lint tests/dev/lint -maxdepth 1 -type f -print | sort; rg -n "lint_no_debugger|no-debugger|set_trace\(|breakpoint\(" . --glob '!*.lock' --glob '!*.min.js' 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,300p'
rg -n "\[tool\.ruff|select =|extend-select|T100|flake8-debugger|debugger" pyproject.toml .pre-commit-config.yaml .github/workflows | sed -n '1,280p'; nl -ba pyproject.toml | sed -n '570,690p'

```bash

```

Targeted use scans the supplied files, including files outside aggregate roots:

```bash
python -m dev.lint.lint_no_debugger tests/example.py omnigent/example.py
```
